title: Outlook: send local Word, Excel and PowerPoint files by email from the new Outlook for Windows
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's updated notice, including the later GCC rollout and the on-by-default state. The licensing description and mailbox-access commands are supported; targeted searches found no documented switch specific to sharing local Office files.

claims.claim: No admin UI path is documented for setting the OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled mailbox-access control.
claims.quote: Searched: OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled Exchange admin center UI enable disable Outlook Windows mailbox access. Opened mailbox-access and Control installing documentation; read Managing email apps search results. The documented UI controls other protocols, not OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled.

claims.claim: Exchange Online PowerShell supports Set-CASMailbox -Identity <MailboxIdentity> -OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled $false to disable new Outlook access for the specified user mailbox.
claims.quote:
Set-CASMailbox -Identity <MailboxIdentity> -OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled <$true | $false | $null>
This example disables Outlook for Windows for the specified user.

claims.claim: The existing mailbox-access control blocks new Outlook for that work or school account, rather than switching only this file-sharing feature off.
claims.quote:
their account is disabled in Outlook for Windows and they can no longer use Outlook for Windows with that account.

The user can delete the account from Outlook for Windows and then use Outlook for Windows with another account.

claims.claim: Set-OwaMailboxPolicy -Identity <PolicyIdentity> -OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled $false sets the same access restriction through a mailbox policy.
claims.quote:
To enable or disable access to mailboxes in Outlook for Windows in Outlook on the web mailbox policies, use the following syntax:
Set-OwaMailboxPolicy -Identity <PolicyIdentity> -OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled <$true | $false | $null>

claims.claim: The mailbox-policy value applies to all current and future mailboxes that have that policy applied.
claims.quote: The value you specify in the Outlook on the web mailbox policy affects all current and future mailboxes that have the policy applied to them.

claims.claim: The access-control documentation points to the Outlook on the web mailbox policies entry in Feature permissions in Exchange Online for required permissions.
claims.quote: To see what permissions you need, see the "Outlook on the web mailbox policies" entry in the Feature permissions in Exchange Online article.

claims.claim: The OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled cmdlets do not affect the Try the new Outlook toggle in classic Outlook.
claims.quote: The OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled parameter on the Set-CASMailbox or Set-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlets doesn't affect the availability of the Try the new Outlook toggle in classic Outlook.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents True or blank for the mailbox OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled property as access enabled, not as evidence of actual usage.
claims.quote: The value True or blank for the OneWinNativeOutlookEnabled property means access is enabled.
